query: query WindowIssues($owner: String!, $name: String!, $since: DateTime!, $first: Int!, $after: String) { repository(owner: $owner, name: $name) { list: issues(first: $first, after: $after, filterBy: { since: $since }, orderBy: { field: UPDATED_AT, direction: DESC }) { pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } nodes { number title updatedAt author { login } } } } rateLimit { remaining resetAt } }
